clip_texts: SC-08 Cyclist alongside on the inside of a turn
A cyclist or scooter rider rides up on the inside as the vehicle turns, or swerves between lanes round an obstacle

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 20 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h; picked, not seeded)
ODD-05 Crossings: cycle-lane
ODD-16 Traffic participants: bicycle
ODD-04 Junctions: stop-controlled

Cyclist speed and lateral motion: Bound stated by FSR-06.01, not
yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids

SG-04 (ASIL D): Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned
path

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

No steering command whose swept path comes within the safe lateral
distance of the cyclist is executed; the vehicle waits or stops in
lane (FSR-04.01, FSR-04.05, FSR-06.01, FSR-02.02, FSR-03.01,
FM-06, AC-02)

Meant to do: waits for the cyclist
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
Where the hazard lies: HE-04.2 Steers into a cyclist in or beside the lane
